- Autodocs enabled via tags so I only document selected stories

The project is already set up with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, and MUI 5. I'd like the configuration files (`main.ts` and `preview.ts`) generated with all these features, along with any needed package installations and a sample story that demonstrates the Tauri mock and theme wrapper. Can you help me generate this configuration?

# Storybook Configuration Skill

## Overview

This skill generates production-ready Storybook 10 configurations for React projects with Material UI integration and testing capabilities. It focuses on:

- Framework detection for React + Vite
- Design system integration (MUI, Ant Design, Chakra UI)
- Basic accessibility and interaction testing
- Platform-specific mocks for Tauri and Electron
- Performance tuning for development and build

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when:

- Setting up Storybook 10 in a new React project
- Adding MUI integration with a theme provider
- Configuring basic testing (a11y, interaction)
- Including platform mocking for Tauri or Electron
- Optimizing Storybook for faster builds

## Quick Start

```bash
# Detect framework and apply configuration
bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/detect-framework.sh

# The skill will generate .storybook/main.ts and .storybook/preview.ts
```

## Configuration Generation

### Supported Frameworks

| Framework | Storybook Package | Bundler |
|-----------|------------------|---------|
| React | `@storybook/react-vite` | Vite |
| Vue 3 | `@storybook/vue3-vite` | Vite |
| Angular | `@storybook/angular` | Webpack |
| Next.js | `@storybook/nextjs-standalone` | Vite |

### Core Features (2026)

**1. Basic Testing**
- Interaction tests via `@storybook/addon-interactions`
- Accessibility testing via `@storybook/addon-a11y`
- Coverage reports with `@vitest/coverage-v8` (optional)

**2. Documentation**
- Autodocs enabled per story using `tags: ['docs']`
- Built-in actions and controls (no addon needed)

**3. Theme Integration**
- MUI ThemeProvider wrapper (static theme, no toggle)
- Ant Design ConfigProvider support
- Chakra UI ChakraProvider support

## Platform-Specific Setup

### Web Projects (Standard)
No additional configuration needed.

### Tauri Projects
Basic mocking is provided:
```typescript
// preview.ts - Tauri mock
window.__TAURI__ = {
  invoke: async (cmd, args) => console.log('Mock invoke', cmd, args),
  event: { listen: () => {}, emit: () => {} },
};
```

### Electron Projects
- Override target to `web` in webpack final
- Mock `window.api` in preview decorators

## Design System Integration

### MUI Integration (Static Theme)

```typescript
// preview.ts
import { ThemeProvider, createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import CssBaseline from '@mui/material/CssBaseline';

const theme = createTheme({ palette: { mode: 'light' } });

export const decorators = [
  (Story) => (
    <ThemeProvider theme={theme}>
      <CssBaseline />
      <Story />
    </ThemeProvider>
  ),
];
```

### Theme Toggle (Optional)
If a theme toggle is needed, add a global type manually. The skill does not generate one by default.

## Testing Configuration

### Interaction Tests
```bash
npm install --save-dev @storybook/addon-interactions @testing-library/user-event
```

### Accessibility Tests
```bash
npm install --save-dev @storybook/addon-a11y
```

Configure in `preview.ts`:
```typescript
parameters: {
  a11y: { element: '#storybook-root' },
}
```

## Configuration Templates

### React + MUI (Standard)

```typescript
// .storybook/main.ts
import type { StorybookConfig } from '@storybook/react-vite';

const config: StorybookConfig = {
  stories: ['../src/**/*.stories.@(js|jsx|ts|tsx)'],
  addons: [
    '@storybook/addon-a11y',
    '@storybook/addon-interactions',
  ],
  framework: {
    name: '@storybook/react-vite',
    options: { strictMode: true },
  },
  docs: { autodocs: 'tag' },
};

export default config;
```

```typescript
// .storybook/preview.ts
import type { Preview } from '@storybook/react-vite';

const preview: Preview = {
  parameters: {
    actions: { argTypesRegex: '^on[A-Z].*' },
    controls: { matchers: { color: /color/i, date: /Date/i } },
    layout: 'centered',
    a11y: { element: '#storybook-root' },
  },
};

export default preview;
```

### Example Story with MUI and Tauri Mock

```tsx
// src/Button.stories.tsx
import { Button } from '@mui/material';
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react';

const meta: Meta<typeof Button> = {
  title: 'Example/Button',
  component: Button,
  tags: ['autodocs'],
  decorators: [
    (Story) => {
      window.__TAURI__ = window.__TAURI__ || { invoke: (cmd) => Promise.resolve(cmd) };
      return <Story />;
    },
  ],
};

export default meta;

export const Primary: StoryObj<typeof Button> = {
  args: { variant: 'contained', children: 'Click Me' },
};
```

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Framework detected and packages installed
- [ ] MUI theme provider decorator added
- [ ] Basic a11y addon enabled
- [ ] Tauri mock present (if applicable)
- [ ] Autodocs tag set on stories
- [ ] Package.json scripts added

## Best Practices

- Use `tags: ['autodocs']` on components you want documented
- Mock platform APIs inside individual stories rather than globally
- Keep Storybook on a different port (6006) from your main app
- Run `npx storybook --no-open` in CI for faster exits

## Integration Notes

- This skill integrates with **story-generation** to produce framework-specific stories
- For advanced visual regression testing, consider Chromatic integration separately
- For full MUI theme toggle (light/dark), add a custom global type and decorator manually
